material_request_rejection_receipt_seria.uq_rejection_receipt_serial_confirmed: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rejection_receipt_serial_confirmed ON material_request_rejection_receipt_serials (return_id, serial_id) WHERE result IN ('accepted','rejected')

material_request_rejection_receipts.ix_rejection_receipts_return: CREATE INDEX ix_rejection_receipts_return ON material_request_rejection_receipts (return_id, recorded_at)

material_request_rejection_receipt_excep:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_receipt_exceptions (
	receipt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	exception_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_file_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (receipt_id, exception_type), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_receipt_exception_type CHECK (exception_type IN ('shortage','damaged','wrong_material','wrong_serial','rejected')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_receipts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(evidence_file_id) REFERENCES files (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
material_request_rejection_receipt_seria:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_receipt_serials (
	receipt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	return_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	serial_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	damaged BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sku_code VARCHAR(80), 
	serial_no VARCHAR(200), 
	qr_code VARCHAR(250), 
	PRIMARY KEY (receipt_id, serial_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id, return_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_receipts (id, return_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_receipt_serial_result CHECK (result IN ('accepted','rejected','shortage') AND (NOT damaged OR result='accepted')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_receipt_serial_scan CHECK ((result='accepted' AND sku_code IS NOT NULL AND serial_no IS NOT NULL AND qr_code IS NOT NULL) OR (result<>'accepted' AND sku_code IS NULL AND serial_no IS NULL AND qr_code IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(serial_id) REFERENCES inventory_serials (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
material_request_rejection_receipts:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_receipts (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	return_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	handover_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	registration_request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	handover_request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	target_location_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	custody_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_role_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	accepted_qty NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	rejected_qty NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	damaged_qty NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	shortage_qty NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	observed_sku_code VARCHAR(80), 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	trace_request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(handover_id, return_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_progress (id, return_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_receipts_parent UNIQUE (id, return_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_receipts_trace UNIQUE (actor_user_id, trace_request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_receipts_quantities CHECK (accepted_qty>=0 AND rejected_qty>=0 AND damaged_qty>=0 AND shortage_qty>=0 AND damaged_qty<=accepted_qty AND accepted_qty+rejected_qty+shortage_qty>0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_receipts_time_version CHECK (request_version>0 AND authorization_version>0 AND received_at<=recorded_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_receipts_reason CHECK (length(trim(reason))>0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_receipts_sku CHECK ((accepted_qty>0 AND observed_sku_code IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(observed_sku_code))>0) OR (accepted_qty=0 AND observed_sku_code IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(return_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_returns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES material_requests (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_role_assignment_id) REFERENCES role_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash)
)
